steps.message: Transcribe the contents of video clip_69__2023_01_30.mp4 by watching it in VLC player (located in Download) and writing the sequence of strings shown on each frame to the text file clip_69__2023_01_30_transcription.txt in Markor as a comma separated list. For example, if the first frame shows the text "edna" and the second frame shows the text "pineapple", then the text file should contain only the following text: "edna, pineapple".
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i markor"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i markor""
